knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Handled surfaces close to the patient are cleaned more often than minimal-touch ones. Option C is the only one in that group.

Routine practice means a detergent mix at least once a day, plus a clean after any visible dirt or known contamination. Dry dusting, high-level disinfectant and alcohol across large areas are not the everyday method.
The guideline limits wipes to single items and small areas. Option B reflects that limit; the others are not stated in the guideline.

practicalCriteria: Learner sorts at least six surfaces in the assigned area into the correct group.
Learner demonstrates the correct method for one high-contact surface and one minimal-touch surface, in the correct order.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Area checklist completed during the observation
stopWorkCriteria: Fluid from a patient is visible on a surface and the response has not yet started
Learner cannot identify the facility's surface list for the area
